sourceDoc: tools/homm3_import/faction_concepts/homm3_factory.json and the user-approved Olden Era split-path design

mechanics.reason: HotA Factory has no faction secondary skill. This Olden Era faction skill (user design 2026-11-16, replaces Split Assembly; id kept) grants the Logistics Network adventure spell: visited mines and dwellings take enhancements up to skill rank 1/2/3 and link in range into a network that pools resources, pays gold and delivers creatures. Runtime: Homm3FactoryLogisticsRuntime, custom_factions/factory_logistics/logistics_config.json.
Generated city row grants +1 crystal per day.
Generated city row grants +3 weekly growth to the Armadillo line.

Building pass 2026-11-22: Build_Mother_Nature moves from the +1 Knowledge visit donor (heroBonusBanks) to a plugin-only banks carrier at the HotA cost (1000 Gold, 5 Ore, needs Fort). Homm3FactoryManaGeneratorRuntime gives the defending hero in a siege of this town +20 mana for the battle and removes whatever is left of those 20 after the battle result, as the HotA Mana Generator does.

Building pass 2026-11-22: the grail keeps its HumanGraal extras (owner answer 3) and adds the HotA strike: Homm3FactoryLightningRodRuntime, at round 1 of every battle with a friendly hero, hits each enemy stack once for the sum over the side's Factory towns with the grail of 7 x (4 + distinct built buildings, upgrades not counted). Several Rods add up.

Building pass 2026-11-22: own row Build_Factory_Loan_Bank (banks carrier, HotA cost 500 Gold, 5 Ore, no requirement). Homm3FactoryLoanBankRuntime pays 2500 Gold when the Bank is built and takes 500 Gold at each of the next 5 day starts (debt kept in the save). Substituted because, by owner decision (REVIEW 2), the loan comes once with construction instead of a repeatable take-a-loan action in the building. The economy Build_Bank is renamed Counting House so the names differ.
